sentences.text: Notably, this is a case where the First Information Report has been lodged under Section 376 and other Sections of I.P.C. as well as the relevant Sections of POCSO Act.

The statement of the prosecutrix is supporting the prosecution version, therefore, the present applicant should approach the learned trial court by filing regular bail application and pleas and grounds, which have been taken in this application, may be taken before the learned trial court.

5. Accordingly, without entering into merits of the issue, I hereby dispose of this application finally at the admission stage giving liberty to the applicant to appear/ surrender before the learned trial court within a period of two weeks from today and may file his regular bail application taking all pleas and grounds which are available with him and if the present applicant appears/ surrenders before the learned trial court concerned within the aforesaid stipulated time and files his regular bail application

, such regular bail application may be considered and decided by the learned trial court concerned with expedition, strictly in accordance with law, by affording an opportunity of hearing to the parties concerned and without giving any unnecessary adjournment to any of the parties.
[Rajesh Singh Chauhan,J.]
